newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-North eyes A$1bln iron ore project.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-North eyes A$1bln iron ore project.

text.p: Australian miner North Ltd said on Friday it was keen to proceed to a full feasibility study on a new iron ore project in the country's northwest, estimating the deposit would cost up to A$1 billion to develop.
North's board on Friday approved the option of a feasibility study for the West Angelas project, but its Japanese joint venture partners have yet to make a decision, North said.
North estimates the West Angelas resource at 694 million tonnes and the reserve at 539 million tonnes with a cut-off grade of 55 percent iron ore.

If given the go-ahead, the project would be developed by North subsidiary, Robe River Iron Associates, which is also owned by Nippon Steel Australia Pty Ltd, Mitsui Co Ltd and Sumitomo Metal Australia Pty Ltd.

A North spokesman said the estimated capital cost of up to A$1 billion took into account the construction of a rail link to Cape Lambert on the northwest coast and an upgrade of port facilities there. -- Melbourne Bureau 613-9286-1421
